notes: NEW: Smart Outfit Color Harmonizer now supports TWO outfit colors! Choose a primary color and an accent color in BC Appearance or Essentials Wardrobe, then apply both across worn clothing with coordinated shades. Multi-zone garments alternate both hues. Swap Colors and Undo are included. Previously chosen primary colors carry over; the accent is saved separately. All v3.5.53 fixes and optional emoticon button settings are retained.

items: Two independent color pickers and HEX entries (Primary and Accent) for Smart Outfit Color Harmonizer.
Apply Both Colors across currently worn clothing: primary tones for main garments, accents for lower pieces and accessories, and both shades in compatible multi-color layers.
Swap Colors button and independent per-account color persistence.
One-step Undo, ownership/lock restrictions, existing Wardrobe and Appearance access, and Color Studio.
Hide Emoticon Button preference, plushie/chat emoticons, and Pet Bed protection/restoration.
